Delivered: both Group editors (the settings popover and the wide toolbar) leave out fields the object declares virtual, judged by `isVirtualSearchField` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the server's own predicate. When a grouping the reader added names a virtual field, the list drops that level from the query, draws an inline notice, and offers a one-click remove. A grouping the view itself declares still shows the error (rulings A and F unchanged).
